1008540790816231424.a: Custom Qubes seem painful in 3.2. Building templates with custom kernel assumes Linux. Could use mini kernels except if I write a kernel which needs 30MB RAM then 3.2 will insist on a min of 300MB. Also, initfs is only needed if you have actual filesystems, just sayin. 0 byte fs.

1008542380025401346.a: Remember you can attach PCI and USB hardware to these domains. If one attached, for example, an Arduino-like board (ARM, MIPS, etc?) via USB or PCI... Run instructions on a real CPU? (gasp) Interface to hardware for robots. Run AI simulations in lean GPU based domains. Powerful.

1008544225506537472.a: Probably time to look deeply into Qubes 4 and see if this is more feasible with the new system design. The Admin API looks like it might be useful. I envision an AI-trained domain which can analyze a blob of code given to it and launch the appropriate environment to run it.
